I have made substantial contributions to the company's growth and success, 
starting with smaller tasks like bug fixes and optimizations and style improvements.
As I earned trust, I took on larger projects,
culminating in a major migration to Immer technology, 
which involved modifying over 2,000 lines of code with no follow-up issues. 
Notably, I have successfully optimized performance, 
reducing memory usage by about 50% and achieving 10-15x speed improvements. 
I am currently leading the development of an LLM agent evaluation framework, utilizing the Langgraph framework.
